title: commands-response
description: Long-poll response: waiting commands for this cabinet, or an empty list after up to pollSeconds (default 25). A command stays leased to the agent until the agent acknowledges it (the next poll's ack list) or posts its result; one not acknowledged within 30 seconds is offered again, and the agent answers a repeat from its own result store.

pollSeconds.description: How long the server holds the next poll, chosen by the server (load, NAT behaviour). The agent uses its default (25) when absent.

reconnectAfterMs.description: The server is shutting down or shedding load: wait this long (already randomised by the server) before the next request.
